title: Primal-dual dynamical systems with closed-loop control for convex optimization in continuous and discrete time
summary: This paper develops a primal-dual dynamical system where the coefficients are designed in closed-loop way for solving a convex optimization problem with linear equality constraints. We first introduce a ``second-order primal" + ``first-order dual'' continuous-time dynamical system, in which both the time scaling and Hessian-driven damping are governed by a feedback control of the gradient for the Lagrangian function.
